findings.root_cause: Incident creation omitted the canonical evidence identity guard used by POST /samples.
findings.remediation: Canonical sensor_id+node_id+observed_at identity rejects identical and conflicting initial duplicates atomically before runtime, audit, or SQLite persistence; samples share the helper while preserving idempotent retransmission.
findings.invariant_restored: Initial evidence cannot silently multiply authority-bearing evidence.

findings.root_cause: frozen_flag was omitted during SensorObservation-to-SensorSeries conversion and therefore from evidence hashing and trust authority.
findings.remediation: Preserve frozen provenance, hash it, cap the existing health feature at the pre-existing corpus frozen-health value of 0.25, expose FROZEN to operators, and suppress planning when all current sensors are frozen.
findings.invariant_restored: Frozen evidence cannot retain healthy planning authority and cannot share a cached evidence identity with healthy evidence.

findings.root_cause: The RequestValidationError response retained non-JSON-serializable validator exception objects in ctx.
findings.remediation: Explicitly sanitize type, loc, msg, url, datetime and safe nested context; omit raw input, exception objects, nonfinite values, and unsupported objects.
findings.invariant_restored: Malformed contracts produce controlled non-leaking 422 responses before handler-side mutation.

extreme_finite_outlier.result: No API/model/calibration/OOD runtime range policy exists; no arbitrary threshold added and no new finding assigned.

frozen_train_serve_parity.remediation: Live drift is derived as drift_flag OR frozen_flag, matching training frozen telemetry while retaining provenance-only frozen metadata.

evidence_certificate_authority.invariant: EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENT and Planning gate satisfied require planning_allowed == true

adv22_detector.remediation: Replaced obsolete negative detector with a positive LIVE provenance and MISS/HIT regression.
